entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • UnsafeAccessorType targeting non-existing type crashing on Linux #116676

  • Occasional failure in "browser-wasm windows Release LibraryTests: Build Product" #116671
